articles.title: CompTIA Cloud+ CV0-004: The Vendor-Neutral Cert That Proves You Can Operate Any Cloud
articles.excerpt: Cloud+ CV0-004 launched in November 2024 with five updated domains — operations weighted at 28%, DoD 8570-approved, and no vendor lock-in. The only mid-level cert that tests you across the full cloud operations lifecycle on AWS, Azure, and GCP simultaneously.

articles.title: CKA — Certified Kubernetes Administrator: The Hands-On Cert That Proves You Can Run Production Clusters
articles.excerpt: Unlike every other major IT cert, the CKA gives you no multiple-choice questions — just a live terminal, a Kubernetes cluster, and 2 hours to complete 15–20 tasks. Troubleshooting carries 30% of the weight. Complete domain breakdown and the prep strategy that actually works.

articles.title: AWS Certified Security – Specialty (SCS-C02): The Cert That Separates Cloud Builders from Security Practitioners
articles.excerpt: SCS-C02 spans six domains — threat detection, logging and monitoring, infrastructure security, IAM, data protection, and governance. With cloud misconfiguration now behind the majority of data breaches, this is the AWS cert that proves you can actually secure production workloads, not just deploy them.

articles.title: CompTIA Network+ N10-009: The Vendor-Neutral Cert That Proves You Understand Networking
articles.excerpt: N10-009 launched in March 2024 with five redesigned domains adding zero trust architecture, SD-WAN, Wi-Fi 6, and stronger IPv6 coverage. Vendor-neutral, DoD 8570-approved, and the fastest path to Security+ or CCNA — here's the complete breakdown.

articles.title: Cisco DevNet Associate: The Cert That Proves You Can Automate Networks — Not Just Configure Them
articles.excerpt: Network automation is no longer optional. Cisco's DevNet Associate (DEVASC 200-901) tests Python scripting, REST APIs, Cisco DNA Center, and infrastructure automation — proving you can code networks, not just configure them.

articles.title: AWS Certified AI Practitioner: The Entry-Level Cert That Signals You Understand the AI Layer
articles.excerpt: AWS launched the AI Practitioner (AIF-C01) in 2024 as the foundational cert for the AI era. Five domains covering generative AI, Bedrock, SageMaker, responsible AI, and AI security — here's what to study and why it belongs on every cloud professional's cert roadmap.

articles.title: Cisco CCNA 200-301: The One Exam That Proves You Know Networking
articles.excerpt: In 2020, Cisco consolidated six separate CCNA tracks into one 200-301 exam covering network fundamentals, VLANs, OSPF, security, and Python-driven automation. Six domains, 120 minutes, simulation questions you can't bluff. Here's the complete breakdown and lab strategy.

articles.title: Google Cloud Associate Cloud Engineer: The Cert That Opens Every GCP Door
articles.excerpt: The GCP ACE covers five domains: compute, storage, networking, IAM, and operations. With Google Cloud growing faster than any other major cloud platform and fewer certified candidates than AWS or Azure, passing the ACE in 2026 puts you in rare company.

articles.title: Microsoft Makes MFA Mandatory for Azure — What AZ-104 and AZ-500 Candidates Must Know
articles.excerpt: No opt-outs, no exceptions. Microsoft's phased MFA enforcement hit the Azure portal in October 2024 and the CLI, PowerShell, and IaC tools in early 2025. Here's what changed, what's excluded, and why it's now a live exam topic for AZ-104, AZ-500, and SC-300.

articles.title: How to Pass CompTIA Security+ SY0-701 — The Complete Study Guide
